contract: A23-109 / A23-110: the sub KO1 'The King's Hop' starts by itself after M1_2 for a Lv <= 8 save with no potion (no stock, none bought or drunk, Requires.MaxLevel / NoPotionYet), as a plain row (no popup, no toast, no Start / Finish): Defeat the King Slime (Event FirstKO) -> Buy a potion (Event PotionBought, TopUpGold 50: the missing part of 50 gold is added to the carried gold once, source Choice, nothing when already rich or when the step passes at once) -> Put the potion in a quick slot (Event QuickSlotSet; Held = data.QuickSlots with a letter in it passes it at once) -> Drink it from your quick slot (Event PotionUsed) -> Defeat the King Slime (a Personal kill: only a personal King Slime in the meadow counts, shared kills never) -> two minutes of hunting gold + XP and one 70% scroll, once. StoryQuestService.Event(player, name, info) = the one way a service reports a named happening (listed in Config.StoryQuests.Events; unknown names, non-players, players not ready: nothing): it is saved in data.Story.First[name] first, the open Event step that waits for it moves on, the next steps are checked at once; an Event step with Past passes at once when its happening was seen before it opened (never a dead end for a player who ran ahead); a client has no way to report one (StoryAction is Open / Talk / Choose and an Event step has no panel). Wants(player, name) = a step waits for it; CurrentStep(player, id) = the step of a started quest. Config.FirstKO = { Quest, Step, RematchStep } is what game dev 2's personal King reads.
limitations: The shop / drink hooks and the practice sip (full HP / MP) are tested in tools/test_potions.py. The personal King itself (hop, landing, lossless KO, rematch numbers) is game dev 2's; the row guide, the quick-slot highlight and the KO screen are game dev 1's. The 1 s loop timing is modelled by calling Refresh by hand.
